Power Stations | Technical Procedure
Introduction
This document outlines the equipment inspection I1, which must be performed on 
monthly bases as indicated by M1 in the title block.
The test of the foam fire system without discharge of the foam solution should 
be made monthly. The test is to assure that the solenoid will open when receive 
the signals given by the two heat sensitive cables
Technical Specifications:
Heat Sensitive Cables: | 
Type: | Double cored insulated
Core Material: | Stainless Steel
Insulation Breadown | 90c
The first initiated by eng. Yousry Abd El-Halim Abd El-Latif, tested by eng. 
Wasfy William Nashed, accepted by general manager eng. Ahmad Fathy Youssef, 
approved by eng. Mohamed Farag Anan head sector of Demiatta power station.
This document is revised by chemist Ahmad El-Sayed Ibrahim, reviewed by eng. 
Soliman Zaki Soliman general manager of guaranty and
quality
insurance, approved by eng. Mohamed Hussein Gomaa head sector of 
of guaranty and quality insurance.
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued.
The maintenance staff should 
 carry the suitable ID safety category.
Maintenance staff should be 
 well trained, qualified or directly supervised by some one who is
Safety fence with caution 
 marks surrounding the work area is required
Wear the personal protective 
 equipment must used as safety shoes, safety helmet ...etc
Secure the isolation of the foam fire system to prevent discharge of the 
 foam to the fuel oil in the tanks
Before carrying out the test inform the authorities in charge
Tools and Equipments
Wrench set.
Screw drivers set, 
Pliers.
Wrench set.
Screw drivers set, 
Pliers.
Close the manual isolate gate valve before the automatic deluge valve for each 
 three tanks
Simulate the alarm conditions of the two heat sensitive cables of the each 
 tank apart
Be sure that the solenoid of the deluge valve will open when receive the 
 signals of the two heat sensitive cables
Check the electric alarm transmission to the fire alarm panel
After the test
Reset the alarm conditions and the alarm panel
Be sure that the solenoid valve is closed
Open the manual isolate gate valve
Reset the alarm conditions and the alarm panel
Be sure that the solenoid valve is closed
Open the manual isolate gate valve
Now the foam fire system is in operational condition
